title: Funny Pictures
text:
Comic strips are short stories with pictures. They are often in newspapers and magazines. Most comic strips have three or four pictures in a row. Each picture shows one part of the story.

My favourite comic strip is about a cat named Tom. Tom always wants to eat fish. In every story, he runs away from the dog. I like it because it is funny.

questions.text: Where are comic strips often found?
What is the name of the cat in the second paragraph?
Why does the writer probably enjoy the comic strip?
How does Tom probably feel about the dog?
options: He is afraid of the dog
He loves the dog very much
He wants to play with the dog
He wants to buy the dog

vocabulary.definition: drawings or photos that show people, places, or things
thin printed publications with articles and pictures, usually published every week or month
accounts of events, real or imaginary, told to entertain or inform

paragraph_translations: Комікси — це короткі історії з картинками. Вони часто бувають у газетах і журналах. Більшість коміксів мають три-чотири картинки в ряд. Кожна картинка показує одну частину історії.
Мій улюблений комікс про кота на ім'я Том. Том завжди хоче їсти рибу. У кожній історії він тікає від собаки. Мені він подобається, тому що він смішний.
